exposure: wanting mental health treatment but lacking access
previous experience with text message psychotherapy
outcome: willingness to engage in psychotherapy via text message
cohort: 897 adult mothers who had given birth in the previous 24 months, had at least one lifetime symptom of depression, had internet access, and could read English.
finding: Most peripartum mothers with depressive symptoms wanted mental health care but lacked access, and over half were willing to engage in psychotherapy via text message.
cross-section timing: Participants were surveyed within 24 months of giving birth.
